verdict: Spend climbed sharply this week; leads and key milestones need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 7 attributed leads at a cost of $252.54 each, all coming from Meta — while Google Ads recorded 12 conversions that are not yet reflected in the lead count due to a confirmed tracking mismatch, which is being corrected now. Google ad spend nearly doubled week-over-week, with $107.82 pushed on September 7 alone, but that spike did not produce a corresponding increase in leads, so spend pacing is being reviewed. Your Google Business Profile recorded zero actions for the nine days ending September 7, down from 98 actions across the full 28-day window; this points to a listing issue rather than ad performance, and it is being investigated. Six planned milestones — including the intake owner confirmation, Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, booking-bot test, and LSA heating toggle — remain overdue, and resolving these is the priority heading into the fall heating season.
